Recipe:
Fluffy Pancakes 4-6 A VanOrman Original
§ion;
We ran out of pancake mix one day and decided to try to make our own recipe. This is what we came up with.
They are light, fluffy and sweet, but extremely simple to make.
Flour1 Cup Baking Soda1 teaspoon Baking Powder1½ teaspoon Sugar1 Tablespoon Egg1 Vegetable Oil¼ Cup Milk¾ Cup
Put all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Cook on a preheated griddle.
Do not stir the batter too much!
For best results, it should have a bunch of small lumps that are a little smaller than peas.
To make Buttermilk Pancakes, replace Milk with Buttermilk.
See, I told you it was simple. &smiley;
